name: Container Namespace Isolation
description: shark-browser-test must filter for shark-* prefix only, never use tst-* or non-shark containers

evidence.fixApplied: Removed Priority 3 (any container). findTestContainer now only returns shark-browser-* (P1) or shark-* (P2) containers. Auto-spawns shark-browser-{date} (P3) if none found.
evidence.codeChanged: src/tools/shark-browser-test.ts findTestContainer() - removed non-shark container fallback, added auto-spawn

criteria.passCondition: Tool only uses shark-* containers or auto-spawns shark-browser-{date}
criteria.failCondition: Tool tries to use tst-*, spider-*, trident-* or any non-shark container
